scope: All 50 current Mineral resources records; tiers and editable rarity defaults only.
remoteHeadVerified: 2026-10-16; authenticated git ls-remote origin HEAD matches inspected cache HEAD
method: Relative gameplay value from useful applications, available material fraction, replacement effort and lore-supported scarcity. Raw state alone does not force T0. No quota per tier. Rarity is seeded from tier once and remains manually editable.
tier4Decision: No current mineral record specifies an exceptional qualified grade or unique find strongly enough to justify T4/Epic. Reserve it for explicitly authored exceptional mineral grades rather than promoting every named gemstone.
boundaries: All six external material/economy records are canon_status proposal, status draft. Their economic patterns inform provisional local catalog assignments. Specific terrestrial minerals, deposits, abundance, prices, optical grades and recipes remain proposals. Existing game rules and author-established resource families take precedence. No source-repository writes or gameplay/recipe changes.

game-world.status: Game canon; author-established resource families and value-tier scope, specific mineral roster remains proposal

existing-item.status: Existing local item proposal; use and recovery description, not accepted deposit canon
